jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager - Automations
jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role CRM at LemFi doesn't run on batch and blast. As Senior CRM Manager - Automations, you'll own the lifecycle journeys that carry a customer from first sign-up to their tenth product, across remittance, credit, savings and the insurance products coming next. This is the person who builds onboarding, retention, reactivation, referral and cross-sell journeys that adapt to real customer behaviour, not a calendar. You'll sit close to Product, Data and Growth, and report directly into the Head of CRM. Your journeys are core infrastructure for the business. Get them right and every other campaign, product launch and market entry gets easier. What you’ll build and own Design and own the lifecycle journeys, onboarding, retention, reactivation, that run without you touching them daily. Build referral and virality programmes that turn customers into the acquisition channel. Launch cross-sell journeys that introduce customers to credit, savings and insurance at the right moment, not the loudest one. Set up the triggers, segments and logic that make each journey react to real behaviour. Test, measure and iterate. Kill what doesn't move the number, scale what does. Partner with Product and Data to get the event tracking and attributes your journeys actually need. Report on lifecycle performance in numbers a CMO can act on, not a dashboard nobody opens. Your experience 4+ years in CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation, ideally in fintech or another high-frequency product. Pro

jobs.title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Finance Data (FinOps)
jobs.description: About Finom Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data What You Will Be Doing - Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them. - Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day. - Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand. - Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work. - Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions. - Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them. - Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses. - Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work. - Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value. jobs.title: Technicien essais R&D
jobs.description: Rejoignez une entreprise à la pointe de l'innovation ! Eco-Tech Ceram conçoit, finance et met en œuvre des solutions de décarbonation de la chaleur industrielle : valorisation de la chaleur fatale, électrification des procédés (Power-to-Heat) et stockage thermique. Nos technologies : l’ Eco-Stock® (stockage thermique haute température), l’E-Burner® (générateur d'air chaud électrique), l’E-Boiler (chaudière électrique) et échangeurs de récupération — fournissent aux industriels une chaleur propre et compétitive, sous forme d'air chaud, d'eau chaude ou de vapeur. Basée en région toulousaine, Eco-Tech Ceram compte aujourd’hui 20 collaborateurs. Forte de 10 ans d’expérience, d’un solide capital technologique, d’une R&D reconnue et de projets industriels réussis, l’entreprise vient de réaliser une levée de fonds de 16 M€ pour accélérer son déploiement en Europe. Dans ce contexte, Eco-Tech Ceram étoffe son équipe technique et recrute un(e) Technicien(ne) d'essais R&D pour prendre part au programme d'essais de l'E-Burner. Votre mission consistera à conduire les essais qui valideront la performance et la robustesse de l’E-Burner. Rattaché à l’ingénieur conception, le Technicien d’essais R&D conduit le programme d’essais de l’E-Burner®, le brûleur électrique sans flamme d’Eco-Tech Ceram, et de l’Eco-Stock®, son stockage de chaleur haute température. Il est en charge de la préparation, de la mise en service et du suivi des essais réalisés sur les équipements innovants développés par Eco-Tech Ceram. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ETC, notamment le bureau d’études, ainsi qu’avec les différents partenaires techniques et prestataires intervenant dans le cadre des essais et développements. Vos missions seront les suivantes : Préparer l’installation des équipements et des moyens d’essais sur les plateformes ETC ou directement chez les clients industriels. Réaliser les opérations de mise en service, de réglage et de validation des équipements afin d'assurer

jobs.title: Strategic GTM Lead - Insurance DACH
jobs.description: About The Role Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH : someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business. This is not a classic sales role. You will open new strategic insurance accounts and grow them into long-term partnerships, from the first executive conversation to large, account-level commitments. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering.
